drawings.description: à gauche, deux croquis de plans : l'un traversé par une droite épaisse portant un point, l'autre marqué d'un seul point
drawings.kind: two planes in perspective (one crossed by a line)
drawings.notes: Two parallelograms (planes in perspective), one above the other: the first crossed by a thick line carrying a point, the second marked with a single point; its lower edge is doubled, drawn as a second stroke. The strokes at the top left and right of the crop belong to the sketch above and to the text. The other sketches of the left margin (the cone, the line Z' bar through a point, Z' bar minus a point) are described in the transcription's notes, not in this mark, and are not drawn.

figures.what: plane crossed by a thick line with a point

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, sous la note cerclée, un croquis : un plan en perspective, surmonté d'un trait fléché vers « $\overline{Z'}$ » ; un trait horizontal aboutit à un point marqué, dans un cercle étiqueté « $\overline{X'}$ » ; près du point, « $y$ ».
drawings.kind: plane with a line ending at a marked point inside a circle
drawings.notes: A rough parallelogram (plane in perspective): left edge, top edge drawn faintly and ending in a small arrow towards the label Z'-bar, bottom edge. A horizontal stroke across the plane ends at a filled point inside a circle labelled X'-bar; the letter y is written just right of the point. A heavy stroke runs along the top of the circle, and a thin line goes down from it through the circle to below the plane's lower edge. Partial: the small strokes inside the circle (a short tick at the top, another beside y) and the short arc at its bottom left are placed by eye, and what they stand for is not clear. The transcription's note calls the figure a cone with its vertex ringed above y; on the page the ring is a circle around the marked point, with y inside it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, deux croquis l'un sous l'autre : une droite épaisse « $\overline{Z'}$ » coupée par une droite fine « $\overline{X'} - \overline{U'}$ » en un gros point ; puis la droite épaisse « $\overline{Z'}$ » interrompue, un petit point dans l'interruption.
drawings.kind: two sketches: a line meeting another at a point; a line with a point removed
drawings.notes: Top: a heavy oblique line labelled Z'-bar, crossed at a large filled point by a thin line labelled X'-bar minus U'-bar; both lines pass through the same computed point. Bottom: the heavy line Z'-bar again, broken, with a small filled point in the gap. Left out: the heavy scribble over the bar of U' (an overwritten or struck bar). The transcription's note matches the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: line Z' meeting X' - U' at a point
